evidence.scope: Published identities/methods and original evidence, not verification of benchmark-authored extensions.
evidence.context: Main PDF p7; SI PDF pp6–7 identities/synthesis, p17 computational/spectral context, pp22–30 coordinates and NTOs. PQCZCS neutral formula C41H32N2O2; the SI C41H33N2O2 [M+H]+ formula is not the neutral calculation. Earlier two-molecule outputs showed sizable blue shifts and AQ-local S1 character. These are reasons to calibrate method/state mapping, not to force every S1 to ICT. No complete PQ/common-torsion reference exists in this upgrade.

evidence.description: Determine how acceptor identity and donor–acceptor torsion separately influence the low-energy singlet excited states of NPCZCS, AQCZCS and PQCZCS. Discriminate locally excited and charge-transfer character using matched physical states, and test whether an acceptor-only explanation survives geometric controls.
